findings.fix: Either remove the required attribute or implement conditional validation that only requires it for business account types.
findings.violation: Company website is marked as required, but this field may not be applicable to all customer types (e.g., individual consumers rather than businesses).

findings.evidence: `placeholder="Must be 8 digits"` with no maxlength, minlength, or pattern validation
findings.fix: Add maxlength="8" and pattern="[0-9]{8}" attributes to enforce the constraint.
findings.violation: The field specifies "8 digits" in the placeholder but has no validation to enforce this constraint.

findings.fix: Add a placeholder explaining the expected format and validation attributes (minlength, maxlength, and/or pattern) appropriate to the account number format.
findings.violation: Account number field has no format specification, placeholder, or validation despite being marked as required and numeric.

findings.evidence: `<option>Standard</option>` and four other options without value attributes
findings.fix: Add value attributes to each option: `<option value="standard">Standard</option>`, `<option value="express">Express</option>`, etc.
findings.violation: Select options lack value attributes and will submit display text (including "Next-day" with a hyphen) as form values instead of normalized identifiers.

findings.evidence: Two separate fields labeled "Full name" (name-input) and "Your name" (legalname-input)
findings.fix: Remove one of the duplicate name fields, or if both are necessary, rename one to clarify its distinct purpose (e.g., "Legal name for contracts").
findings.violation: The form contains two fields asking for a person's name, which appears redundant and creates user confusion about what to enter in each field.

findings.fix: Change to `type="time"` or replace with a select element containing predefined options like Morning, Afternoon, or Evening.
findings.violation: Text input is inappropriate for collecting a time preference; the expected format is ambiguous to users.
